items.label: Researcher profile and My Publications
items.data_source: curated three-paper sandbox plus bounded OpenAlex graph capture
items.visitor_note: Saved identity, two authored publications, coherent metrics and cited-by histories, a research-summary draft, an honest two-paper domain presentation, and grounded-prospection results.

items.label: My Publications corpus
items.visitor_note: Two genuine Workman publications are identified inside the three-paper corpus.

items.label: Citation gaps
items.data_source: production co-citation workflow over bounded OpenAlex metadata
items.visitor_note: Twenty-five candidates retain the shared-reference anchors from the unchanged 2021 publication; the coverage note explicitly states that the fallback does not attribute edges to the replacement paper.

items.label: Emerging citing topics
items.visitor_note: Four positive descriptive topic increases retain every retrieved citing work behind the recent and earlier counts; flat topics are excluded.

items.label: Authors citing your work
items.visitor_note: Three recurring public author connections satisfy the displayed two-work/two-publication threshold and retain their complete evidence; no collaboration fit is inferred.
